crime_highlights: Mr. Hughes was shouting at Ms. Denham from outside the residence
Mr. Hughes picked up the shotgun.
Mr. Hughes moved from the foyer to the living room while holding the shotgun.
It was then that the shotgun unintentionally discharged once, shooting her in the abdomen.
rationale_highlights: The Gladue Report provided some further details about Mr. Hughes' upbringing and the intergenerational trauma that no doubt played a role in his development.
I have read the reports and agree with Mr. Dhanu's submission about the impact this background has had on Mr. Hughes.
note: Offender did not rely on 718.2(e); Gladue used as background only, never mitigating.

crime_highlights: RCMP forced the door open and found Ms. Monk unconscious with blood on her face, and Mr. Beynon on the couch, shirtless, with blood on his hands.
Ms. Monk was diagnosed on an interim basis with extensive intracranial bleeding with hemorrhagic stroke, with extensive lacerations on the face, head, and facial swelling.
Pieces of glass were lodged in her scalp.
Ms. Monk was transported to Vancouver General Hospital but died from her injuries on February 8, 2022.
Mr. Beynon admits that he committed the offence of manslaughter of Ms. Monk by repeatedly striking her in the head or on the head with a bottle.
rationale_highlights: he is a descendent of a number of residential school survivors, including his mother
the impact of intergenerational trauma resulting from Mr. Beynon's Indigenous background is something that the court is able to consider in determining the extent of his moral culpability
note: Joint submission; Gladue only 'considered', never stated to reduce culpability or sentence.

crime_highlights: Mr. Hughes participated in applying the duct‑tape.
Mr. Hughes and Mr. McLaughlin also joined in the punching.
The hot coin applied to Mr. Nicholson's chest was a weapon, as well as the lighter fluid rubbed on to the shoulders and then set aflame.
Mr. Hughes' actions that night made it difficult for Mr. Nicholson to leave, so Dante can inflict the injuries with the coin and the lighter fluid.
rationale_highlights: Another important factor to be considered is Mr. Hughes' indigenous heritage.
His background makes him in some sense as vulnerable as Mr. Nicholson.
He was neglected as a child, sexually abused, and did not have a stable home life.
note: Heritage listed as considered; court never states it reduced culpability or sentence.
